notes: Checklist (strings only, the body-text items 10 and 11 do not apply): 1 Letters PASS, ASCII-stripped forms found: none (read all 95 strings; every ç ğ ı İ ö ş ü present where the word needs it; capital dotted İ in 'İçeriğe', 'İletişim'; no 'Ilk'-type error: none; the verifier's CASE and i+U+0307 guards pass). 2 Name forms PASS: El-Ahsa (6 strings), El-Ahsa Vahası, Arap Körfezi byte-identical to the termbase; Google Haritalar; brand Visit Al-Ahsa and UNESCO, WhatsApp Latin. 3 Suffixes PASS: El-Ahsa'da, El-Ahsa'daki, Arap Körfezi'ndeki, Google Haritalar'da with U+0027 only (vowel per termbase: a, a, i, a); no apostrophe on common nouns (gezilecek yerlerde, vahası-free). 'km'den' after the unit abbreviation takes the apostrophe. 'mı/mi' apart: 'bir bilgi mi'. 4 Address PASS: polite plural throughout; zero sen-forms; no capital 'Siz'. 5 Headings PASS: P9 sentence case in every label and heading (Sıkça sorulan sorular, Ziyaret bilgileri, Tarihî yerler); no final stop on nav labels, card labels or headings; full stops only on the sentences (list.empty, det.nearby.d/note, foot.tagline, foot.independence, search.idle, inline.404.text). 6 Termbase PASS: no violation; 'gezilecek yer' and 'El-Ahsa mutfağı' follow the stage proposals. 7 Punctuation PASS: no « » or straight double quotes in any string; no U+00A0; no U+2019; em dash with spaces on both sides as in the source (map.locate.err, list.lead, det.hoursNotice, search.empty); no space before . , ? ; … used as in the source. 8 Numbers PASS: '1 km', '{n} km' Latin digits; no hours, currency or Hijri in this batch. 9 Anglicisms and bureaucratese PASS: none (no lokasyon/destinasyon/spot; no -mektedir/bulunmaktadır). 10 Glossing PASS (nothing to gloss in labels). 11 Structure PASS: placeholders {op} and {n} and the arrows ↗ → ✓ and the ellipsis … unchanged from the source.

source_defects.defect: ar has an extra clause not in en ('من الأماكن التراثية في الأحساء إلى متاحف الأحساء'); en is the translation source, the Turkish follows en.

The suggest-bar strings are written from the viewpoint of the page being offered ('available in <this language>'); on a Turkish frame they only make sense if a Turkish counterpart of a non-Turkish page exists. Not a text defect; flagged for wiring.
ar is 'واحة الأحساء في اليونسكو' (Al-Ahsa Oasis at UNESCO) while en is only 'UNESCO World Heritage'; Turkish follows en. The label does not claim the link is about El-Ahsa.
